'''2017 MPC Kyle Krueger DS Carbon Chamber Testing''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Kyle Krueger]] at [[2017 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Kyle Krueger]]
* '''Event:''' [[2017 Match Play Championship]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Carbon Chamber Testing / My Favorite Decoration|SE-D-carbonchambertesting.gif}}
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:Open CCT Krueger DS 2017 MPC.txt |Download]]
* '''Format:''' [[Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
* '''Source:''' [https://www.starwarsccg.org/match-play-championship/ PC list] Preserved copy: [https://swccg.com/snapshots/pc/match-play-championship.html swccg.com snapshot], [https://web.archive.org/web/20261014113348/https://swccg.com/snapshots/pc/match-play-championship.html Internet Archive]
